title: Recharging Damage, Cleaning, Tolls and Traffic Fines After a Car Rental
content:
This note states the basis on which sums are recharged to a renter after a Car Rental Rate Classes vehicle
has been handed back.

## A clause no longer in force

*Damage discovered at return or afterwards is recharged to the renter up to the rate class's waiver excess
where the waiver was carried, and in full where it was not.* That clause is **no longer in force**; what a
damage recharge is built from now rests on the current basis and not on this sentence.

Likewise **no longer in force**: *The class's damage administration charge is added once per incident and
never once per damaged part.*

## Conditions that must hold before a recharge is raised

A recharge is raised only while the rental record stands at picked up or returned.

Damage is recharged only when the rental desk has already recorded an approved damage assessment against
this rental. The assessment is a record of the desk's own, and it must stand approved and stand against this
rental; the renter's account of the incident does not answer for it.

Damage found after the vehicle was handed back is recharged only when frozen time — the moment at which the
desk is handling the matter — is not after the moment the renter returned the vehicle to the supplier plus
the damage reporting window of the rate class booked. The damage reporting window is counted in whole
calendar days from the day after the return date, weekends and public holidays included, and a report made
exactly on the closing day is still in time.

**Boundary cases.** Counting begins on the day after the vehicle came back, so the return day itself is not
one of the days of the window. On a class whose window is a number of calendar days, a report made on the
closing day of that count is in time; a report made on the following day is out of time. No weekend or
public holiday is skipped in the count.

## Tolls, fines, soiling and smoke

Tolls and traffic fines incurred during the rental are recharged at the amount the authority charged plus
the class's own administration charge for each toll or each fine.

Excessive soiling and smoking in the vehicle carry the class's own charges and are settled as recharges
rather than as damage.

## A renter who disputes

A renter who disputes a recharge is referred to a review, and the disputed amount stays on the ledger until
the review decides it.

superseded_clauses: The class's damage administration charge is added once per incident and never once per damaged part.
Damage discovered at return or afterwards is recharged to the renter up to the rate class's waiver excess where the waiver was carried, and in full where it was not.
